title: Jagged Midnight Savory British Saeujeot-Shrimp-Paste Bangers and Mash
description: A midnight-craving British dish featuring saeujeot-shrimp-paste, showcasing savory and flaky textures, with a focus on low-fat options.

ingredients.name: Bangers and Mash Bangers
ingredients.notes: British-style sausages, preferably made with pork and a hint of sage.

ingredients.name: Saeujeot-Shrimp-Paste
ingredients.notes: A Korean-inspired shrimp paste that adds depth and umami flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Mushimono Steam Mixture
ingredients.notes: A mixture of equal parts water and white rice, used to steam the bangers and mash.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Low-fat, unsalted butter for added richness without excessive calories.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk for creaminess and moisture in the mash.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: To thicken the mash and create a cozy texture.

ingredients.name: Large onion, diced
ingredients.notes: To add natural sweetness and crunch to the dish.

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: For added depth and complexity to the bangers and mash.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped
ingredients.notes: Garnish and added freshness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: To balance the flavors in the dish.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.notes: To enhance the flavors and textures in the dish.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: To add a touch of piquancy to the dish.

ingredients.name: Low-fat cooking oil
ingredients.notes: For greasing the pans and preventing sticking.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) for the bangers and mash.
Prepare the Mushimono Steam Mixture according to the package instructions.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of low-fat cooking oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes, while occasionally stirring.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Bangers and Mash Bangers to the pan, cooking until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the bangers to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of low-fat cooking oil.
Add the Saeujeot-Shrimp-Paste and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Gradually add the Mushimono Steam Mixture, constantly stirring to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Stir in the butter, milk, and all-purpose flour until the mash is smooth and creamy.
Season the mash with salt, pepper, and black pepper to taste.
Serve the bangers and mash together, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
For an added touch, serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple salad.
